बॉलीवु़ड में पुरानी फिल्मों की वापसी का ट्रेंड लगातार जारी है। 🎬
अक्षय कुमार और सुनील शेट्टी स्टारर क्लासिक एक्शन फिल्म Mohra अब सिनेमाघरों में दोबारा रिलीज होने के लिए पूरी तरह तैयार है। 🍿
ट्रिमूर्ति फिल्म्स प्राइवेट लिमिटेड ने अपने YouTube चैनल पर वीडियो शेयर करके इस बात की पक्की मोहर लगा दी है।
यह धमाकेदार फिल्म 6 नवंबर को Diwali वीक के दौरान सिनेमाघरों में लौट रही है। 🎟️
रिपोर्ट के मुताबिक, इस री-रिलीज का मुकाबला रणबीर कपूर और Yash स्टारर बड़ी फिल्म Ramayana से होगा।
Rimpy Films International के बैनर तले Mohra को 4K रीमास्टर वर्जन में सिनेमाघरों में उतारा जा रहा है। 🎞️
कंपनी ने अपने Instagram Stories पर कंफर्म किया है कि वे Vidhaata, Tridev, Gupt और Yudh जैसी फिल्में भी दोबारा रिलीज करेंगे।
आगरा के Heera Talkies सिंगल-स्क्रीन थिएटर में Mohra के सभी चारों शोज़ रोजाना चलेंगे, जिससे वहां Ramayana नहीं दिखाई जाएगी। 😲
क्या आप सिनेमाघर में जाकर 'Tu Cheez Badi Hai Mast Mast' गाना बड़े पर्दे पर देखना चाहेंगे? नीचे कमेंट्स में जल्दी बताओ!

ctx.text:
The trend of re-releases began in 2024, a year when films like Rockstar (2011), Laila Majnu (2018), Tumbbad (2018), etc. did huge business in their second innings. Meanwhile, in 2025, Sanam Teri Kasam (2016) re-released and stunned the trade by collecting more than Rs. 40 crores, thus emerging as the biggest re-release success of all time. The trend has since died down, though last month, Avengers Endgame: Encore managed to put up impressive numbers. And now, one more classic is all set to return to cinemas – Mohra (1994)!
Yesterday, Trimurti Films Pvt Ltd, the production house behind Mohra , uploaded a video on its YouTube channel confirming the film's re-release. Interestingly, the action entertainer will return to cinemas on November 6, during Diwali week. In other words, Mohra will clash with the much-awaited Ramayana, starring Ranbir Kapoor, Yash, Sai Pallavi and others.
Mohra will be re-released by Deepinder Singh's Rimpy Films International in a 4K remastered version. The company's social media page has been sharing interesting updates about the re-release for several days. Through its Instagram Stories, Rimpy Films International has also confirmed plans to re-release other memorable films produced by Trimurti like Vidhaata (1982), Tridev (1989), Gupt (1994), Yudh (1985), etc.
The company further revealed that one of the cinemas screening Mohra will be Heera Talkies in Agra, Uttar Pradesh. Interestingly, the single-screen theatre will play Mohra in all four shows every day. As a result, it won't be screening Ramayana at all.
Meanwhile, Rimpy Films International has re-released Zora (2025), Rajiv Rai's latest directorial, this week. Incidentally, the film is also playing at Agra's Heera Talkies.
Mohra starred Naseeruddin Shah, Akshay Kumar, Suniel Shetty, Raveena Tandon, Paresh Rawal, Gulshan Grover, Raza Murad, Sadashiv Amrapurkar and Poonam Jhawer. Originally released on July 1, 1994, the film was a blockbuster in cinemas thanks to its mass-appealing moments, ensemble cast, powerful performances and unforgettable music by Viju Shah.
With Mohra being remastered in 4K, watching it on the big screen promises to be a treat, especially for those eager to experience iconic songs like 'Tu Cheez Badi Hai Mast Mast' and 'Tip Tip Barsa Paani' in all their glory in cinemas. However, its clash with a mammoth film like Ramayana could result in limited showcasing. It remains to be seen how the clash plays out and whether Mohra manages to win the love and patronage of audiences in its second innings as well.
